# cloptima_llm_provider_credential (Data Source)

Reads an existing Cloptima LLM provider credential by ID, display name, or provider name. A display name or provider name lookup fails if more than one credential matches.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a provider credential by display name
data "cloptima_llm_provider_credential" "anthropic" {
  display_name = "Anthropic Primary Production"
}

output "anthropic_credential_id" {
  value = data.cloptima_llm_provider_credential.anthropic.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Display name. Specify id, display_name, or provider_name.
- `id` (String) Unique credential identifier. Specify id, display_name, or provider_name.
- `provider_name` (String) Provider identifier (e.g. openai, anthropic, vertex_ai). Specify id, display_name, or provider_name.

### Read-Only

- `api_base` (String) Provider API base URL.
- `api_version` (String) Provider API version.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `credential_location` (String) Credential location: cloud or edge.
- `credential_mode` (String) Credential mode: api_key or oauth_refresh.
- `customer_id` (String) Owning customer ID.
- `project_id` (String) Cloud project ID.
- `region` (String) Cloud region.
- `status` (String) Validation status: active, pending, degraded, or revoked.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
